title: a stock table and every way an insert can meet an existing key

steps.sql:
CREATE TABLE stock (
  sku  text PRIMARY KEY,
  qty  int  NOT NULL,
  seen date NOT NULL
)
steps.note: a stock table keyed by sku.
two teas in stock.

steps.sql: SELECT sku, qty, seen FROM stock ORDER BY sku
steps.note: the table.

steps.sql: INSERT INTO stock VALUES ('TEA-01', 3, '2026-03-02')
steps.note: a plain INSERT of a sku that's already there: the primary key says no, and the whole statement fails.

error.message: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "stock_pkey"

steps.sql: SELECT sku, qty, seen FROM stock ORDER BY sku
steps.note: nothing changed.

steps.sql:
INSERT INTO stock VALUES ('TEA-01', 3, '2026-03-02'), ('TEA-03', 7, '2026-03-02')
ON CONFLICT (sku) DO NOTHING
steps.note: DO NOTHING: TEA-01 conflicts and is skipped, TEA-03 is new and goes in. INSERT 0 1.

steps.sql: SELECT sku, qty, seen FROM stock ORDER BY sku
steps.note: the table after it.

steps.sql:
INSERT INTO stock VALUES ('TEA-01', 3, '2026-03-03'), ('TEA-04', 12, '2026-03-03')
ON CONFLICT (sku) DO UPDATE
SET qty = stock.qty + EXCLUDED.qty, seen = EXCLUDED.seen
steps.note: DO UPDATE: TEA-01 exists, so its row is updated with EXCLUDED, the row you tried to insert. TEA-04 is new and inserted. INSERT 0 2 counts both.

steps.sql: SELECT sku, qty, seen FROM stock ORDER BY sku
steps.note: the table after it.

steps.sql:
INSERT INTO stock VALUES ('TEA-02', 99, '2026-02-01')
ON CONFLICT (sku) DO UPDATE
SET qty = EXCLUDED.qty, seen = EXCLUDED.seen
WHERE EXCLUDED.seen > stock.seen
steps.note: a WHERE on DO UPDATE: this delivery note is older than what we already have, so the update is skipped. INSERT 0 0.

steps.sql: SELECT sku, qty, seen FROM stock ORDER BY sku
steps.note: the table after it: TEA-02 kept its newer row.

steps.sql:
INSERT INTO stock VALUES ('TEA-02', 1, '2026-03-04'), ('TEA-02', 2, '2026-03-04')
ON CONFLICT (sku) DO UPDATE
SET qty = stock.qty + EXCLUDED.qty, seen = EXCLUDED.seen
steps.note: the same sku twice in one statement. the second would update the row the first just wrote, and postgres refuses.

error.message: ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE command cannot affect row a second time

steps.sql: SELECT sku, qty, seen FROM stock ORDER BY sku
steps.note: nothing changed.

steps.sql: BEGIN
steps.note: a transaction to undo it in.

steps.sql:
INSERT INTO stock VALUES ('TEA-01', 3, '2026-03-05')
ON CONFLICT (sku) DO NOTHING
RETURNING sku, qty
steps.note: (sku) names the primary key's column, so the primary key's index is the arbiter. TEA-01 conflicts and is skipped: no rows back.

steps.sql: ROLLBACK
steps.note: undo.

steps.sql: BEGIN
steps.note: a transaction to undo it in.

steps.sql:
INSERT INTO stock VALUES ('TEA-01', 3, '2026-03-05')
ON CONFLICT (sku) DO UPDATE SET qty = stock.qty + EXCLUDED.qty
RETURNING sku, qty
steps.note: (sku) finds the primary key's index, TEA-01 conflicts, and the existing row is updated: 13 + 3.

steps.sql: ROLLBACK
steps.note: undo.

steps.sql: BEGIN
steps.note: a transaction to undo it in.

steps.sql:
INSERT INTO stock VALUES ('TEA-01', 3, '2026-03-05')
ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT stock_pkey DO NOTHING
RETURNING sku, qty
steps.note: naming the constraint picks the same index, without listing its columns.

steps.sql: ROLLBACK
steps.note: undo.

steps.sql: BEGIN
steps.note: a transaction to undo it in.

steps.sql:
INSERT INTO stock VALUES ('TEA-01', 3, '2026-03-05')
ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT stock_pkey DO UPDATE SET qty = stock.qty + EXCLUDED.qty
RETURNING sku, qty
steps.note: the same update, the arbiter named by constraint.

steps.sql: ROLLBACK
steps.note: undo.

steps.sql: BEGIN
steps.note: a transaction to undo it in.

steps.sql:
INSERT INTO stock VALUES ('TEA-01', 3, '2026-03-05')
ON CONFLICT (qty) DO NOTHING
RETURNING sku, qty
steps.note: no unique index on (qty), so there's nothing to arbitrate with, and postgres refuses before inserting anything.

error.message: there is no unique or exclusion constraint matching the ON CONFLICT specification

steps.sql: ROLLBACK
steps.note: undo.

steps.sql: BEGIN
steps.note: a transaction to undo it in.

steps.sql:
INSERT INTO stock VALUES ('TEA-01', 3, '2026-03-05')
ON CONFLICT (qty) DO UPDATE SET qty = stock.qty + EXCLUDED.qty
RETURNING sku, qty
steps.note: the same refusal: a conflict target must match a unique index or constraint.

error.message: there is no unique or exclusion constraint matching the ON CONFLICT specification

steps.sql: ROLLBACK
steps.note: undo.

steps.sql: BEGIN
steps.note: a transaction to undo it in.

steps.sql:
INSERT INTO stock VALUES ('TEA-01', 3, '2026-03-05')
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
RETURNING sku, qty
steps.note: DO NOTHING without a target skips a conflict on any unique index the table has.

steps.sql: ROLLBACK
steps.note: undo.

steps.sql: BEGIN
steps.note: a transaction to undo it in.

steps.sql:
INSERT INTO stock VALUES ('TEA-01', 3, '2026-03-05')
ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET qty = stock.qty + EXCLUDED.qty
RETURNING sku, qty
steps.note: DO UPDATE without a target is refused: postgres needs to know which conflict it's updating for.

error.message: ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE requires inference specification or constraint name

steps.sql: ROLLBACK
steps.note: undo.
